note: Read 2026-10-13 from peregrinebullets.com (robots.txt allows /bullets, /about-us, /wp-content/uploads PDF). Construction: reload-data PDF says all Peregrine bullets are gilding-metal monolithics; Glider = target bullet -> match; Brass Backup (brass monolithic) mapped to monolithic_copper (copper alloy). Tip: only Backup/Brass Backup state a large meplat -> flat_nose. PlainsMaster/BushMaster 'plunging tip/initiator' has no enum value; VLR5, Glider, Subsonic, Rex tip not stated. Base not stated on any line page or store page. Store page /store/308-plainsmaster/ gives no construction details.
